customer_name: Changshu Economic and Technological Development Zone
business_problem: Changshu needed a practical way to accelerate industrial digitalization, cultivate AI talent, and help local manufacturers adopt industrial-internet and AI capabilities at scale rather than through isolated pilots.
solution_summary: Changshu worked with Baidu AI Cloud and local partners to build an 'AI + Industrial Internet' base anchored by the Kaiwu industrial-internet platform, industrial-vision tools, and safety-monitoring applications. The regional program combines one industrial base, two enabling platforms, and three planned centers so local manufacturers can adopt shared AI infrastructure, incubation support, and industrial-internet services instead of building everything independently. Baidu's teams also embedded with factories and worked through concrete production problems while the platform expanded into quality inspection, predictive maintenance, production-environment monitoring, knowledge management, and decision support.
products_used: Safety Production Monitoring and Early Warning Platform

solution_components.name: Kaiwu Industrial Internet Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared industrial-internet backbone used to connect manufacturers, data, and AI applications across the zone.

solution_components.name: Industrial Vision Intelligent Platform
solution_components.role: Supports AI quality-inspection and visual-analysis scenarios in local manufacturing plants.

solution_components.name: Safety Production Monitoring and Early Warning Platform
solution_components.role: Adds AI-based production-safety monitoring and warning capabilities for factory operations.

data_flow: Factory data from production lines, MES, SCADA, and shop-floor monitoring scenarios is brought into the Kaiwu platform, where vision and safety models analyze quality, environment, and equipment conditions. The outputs are then used by manufacturers and zone operators for inspection, warning, scheduling, and industrial-service coordination.
business_outcome: Changshu created a regional AI-and-industrial-internet operating model that helped manufacturers adopt quality, safety, and decision-support applications while also attracting ecosystem partners and supporting industrial talent development.
metrics: A local delivery team engaged with 60+ enterprises in the first 4 months.
The team entered factories more than 500 times to solve real production problems.
architecture_clues: The regional program is described as one base, two platforms, and three centers
Baidu Kaiwu was used for quality inspection, predictive maintenance, production-environment monitoring, knowledge management, and decision support
The solution connects with MES and SCADA as two core digital-manufacturing subsystems
evidence_quotes: Changshu and Baidu AI Cloud reached strategic cooperation to explore new momentum from 'AI + industrial internet' and build a new engine for industrial upgrading and high-quality regional growth (original: 江苏省苏州市常熟市与百度智能云达成战略合作，依托“云智一体”技术优势，发掘“AI+工业互联网”新势能).

The local project aimed to build the Yangtze River Delta's first 'artificial intelligence + industrial internet' program and improve industrial upgrading, industrial-internet development, and talent cultivation (original: 在当地共同建设长三角首个“人工智能+工业互联网”项目…带动苏州人工智能产业化升级以及工业互联网发展和人才培养).

Within four months, the local team connected with more than 60 enterprises and entered factories more than 500 times to solve real problems (original: 公司组建后的4个月时间里，公司员工深入对接60多家当地企业，深入工厂一线解决实际问题500余次).

Kaiwu-based applications landed in leading manufacturers for AI quality inspection, AI safety production, knowledge management, and decision support, with MES and SCADA identified as core subsystems for future rollout (original: 基于“云智一体”的百度智能云开物工业互联网平台…切入工业质检、预测性维护、生产环境监控等更多场景…MES制造执行子系统与SCADA管理子系统两大核心板块).
